narrative.overview: The site is one model response, read top to bottom. The answer streams in token by token, and the rest reads like the tools used to inspect it: a trace waterfall, tokenizer output, a feedback panel and a chat composer. Calm paper, hairline rules, two type voices and one highlighter color per palette.
keyCharacteristics: One highlighter color per palette, used sparingly.
Host Grotesk for people, Martian Mono for machines.
Paper-and-hairline surfaces with one ambient panel shadow.
Five seasonal palettes, each light and dark, on shared roles.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Each palette has exactly one signal color, and it only marks live or important things.

rules.name: The Same Roles Rule
rules.body: New components use role tokens, never hex values.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Machine output in Martian Mono, human voice in Host Grotesk.

rules.name: The Float Only When Floating Rule
rules.body: Only overlapping layers get the pop shadow.

dos: Do use role tokens so changes work across all ten palettes.
Do use the --r-* tokens for every corner.
Do keep press feedback on the spring.
Do keep .block padding as the single vertical rhythm.
donts: Don't add a second highlight color.
Don't change fonts, palettes, radii, highlights, copy or section order.
Don't give inline panels the pop shadow.
Don't replace streamed or springing motion with a generic fade.
